actions.title: Confirm the public lesson boundary
actions.instruction: Read this guided public lesson before running anything. Academy Preview 0.22 publishes U06 and its installed Prepare, Check, and Reset commands are the supported Academy lifecycle.
actions.rationale: The website is the primary lesson surface and the installed Academy lifecycle is available for this accepted lab.
actions.expected_result: You know U06 is a guided, runnable public Academy lesson.
actions.recovery: If the installed command cannot find U06, stop and verify you installed Preview 0.22. Do not run repository-local source as a substitute.
actions.evidence: The Preview 0.22 manifest includes U06 in the available, runnable, and guided lists.

actions.title: Prepare the U06 attempt
actions.instruction: Use the installed Academy Prepare command to create the frozen U06 attempt and candidate.
actions.rationale: Prepare is an Academy lifecycle operation, not a substitute for editing fixtures by hand.
actions.expected_result: Preview 0.22 creates one numbered U06 attempt branch and the frozen candidate file.
actions.recovery: If Prepare stops, preserve its message and correct only the stated repository condition. Do not create an attempt or candidate by hand.
actions.evidence: The printed attempt branch and the frozen candidate path prove preparation completed.

actions.title: Inspect the prepared scenario
actions.instruction: In the prepared attempt, inspect the scenario descriptor before touching the candidate. This is a native terminal command and has no !.
actions.rationale: The descriptor identifies a read-only preview over the attempt tree rather than a sandbox or hosted operation.
actions.expected_result: The descriptor names read_only_preview, attempt-tree, and preview-not-run.
actions.recovery: If the file is absent, stop and run Prepare again; do not create it yourself.
actions.evidence: Retain the exact descriptor path and the attempt branch name.

actions.title: Inspect the frozen candidate
actions.instruction: Read the seeded candidate from the prepared attempt. It is the only learner-editable source in the first learner commit and this direct terminal command has no !.
actions.rationale: The Check profile binds exact prepared and final candidate bytes; a generic document does not pass.
actions.expected_result: You see the intentionally incomplete U06 preview candidate and make no edit yet.
actions.recovery: If its bytes differ from the prepared fixture, stop. Do not normalize or replace the seed.
actions.evidence: The prepared commit and candidate path form the first report binding.

actions.title: Create only the contained candidate diff
actions.instruction: Ask the selected host to replace only docs/U06-preview-candidate.md with the exact reviewed safe Markdown policy and stop before staging. This is a harness instruction, not a shell command, so it has no !.
actions.rationale: The active agent owns the bounded edit; the learner owns inspection and later commits.

actions.expected_result: Only the candidate is modified and it remains unstaged.
actions.recovery: If another path changes or staging begins, stop and preserve the state for review; do not erase it to hide the mistake.
actions.evidence: The first learner commit must contain exactly docs/U06-preview-candidate.md.

actions.title: Inspect the contained diff
actions.instruction: Inspect the unstaged diff before asking for a preview. This native terminal observation has no ! and must show only the candidate path.
actions.rationale: A read-only preview must be grounded in a bounded input, not a vague description of intended work.
actions.expected_result: The only modified path is docs/U06-preview-candidate.md and the policy says preview is read-only.
actions.recovery: If the diff contains another path, do not stage or preview it. Preserve the difference and start a reviewed retry later.
actions.evidence: The candidate SHA-256 and changed_paths will be bound in the final report.

actions.title: Run the host-native read-only preview
actions.instruction: Ask the active CodeArbiter host for a read-only preview of the current diff. This host-native command has no ! and does not commit, stage, push, or execute advanced surfaces.
actions.rationale: ca-preview is a bounded diff review; it is distinct from Academy Preview 0.22, which is the release name and public availability boundary.
actions.expected_result: The host reports an advisory preview of the candidate diff without mutating repository state.
actions.recovery: If the host cannot find the command, do not replace it with shell syntax. Record the unavailable host capability and retain the diff.
actions.evidence: The later Academy binding record names only durable repository facts and not-executed classifications. It does not preserve ca-preview output or claim host invocation proof.

actions.title: Assess the preview as advice
actions.instruction: Read the preview output in the selected host. Confirm it addresses only documentation and does not claim a sandbox run, new skill, hosted watch, or tribunal.
actions.rationale: The learner evaluates advisory output; a repository Check cannot prove the host result was understood.
actions.expected_result: You can state whether the candidate remains a docs-only, read-only policy before staging it.
actions.recovery: If the preview points beyond the candidate boundary, stop and preserve the result instead of expanding scope.
actions.evidence: No committed record preserves this advisory output; the later Academy binding record proves only repository facts and not-executed classifications.

actions.title: Stage only the candidate
actions.instruction: After reviewing the diff, stage only the candidate in a native terminal. This direct command has no !.
actions.rationale: The strict first commit rejects any unrelated path.
actions.expected_result: The staged name list contains only docs/U06-preview-candidate.md.
actions.recovery: If another path is staged, stop and inspect it. Do not use reset, restore, or a broad add to conceal it.
actions.evidence: The candidate commit is the direct child of the prepared commit.

actions.title: Commit the candidate through the gate
actions.instruction: Run the host-native commit gate only after the staged boundary is correct. This is not a shell command and has no !.
actions.rationale: The Academy teaches the governed commit path rather than a raw git commit shortcut.
actions.expected_result: One linear candidate commit is created with no report path in it.
actions.recovery: If the commit gate stops, address only its stated issue or preserve the attempt for Reset. Do not amend or force history.
actions.evidence: The Check compares this commit's tree and candidate bytes with the final report bindings.

actions.title: Classify advanced surfaces without running them
actions.instruction: Record each advanced surface as not run here: sandbox needs Docker and an untrusted target; new-skill needs a demonstrated gap and approved scope; watch needs a real hosted PR and CI; tribunal is a persistent expensive audit, not routine training. Do not execute any of those commands.
actions.rationale: Knowing when not to invoke a powerful operation is part of power-user fluency.
actions.expected_result: You have four explicit not run here classifications and no advanced command execution.
actions.recovery: If a real project qualifies for one surface, leave this lesson and use that operation's own scope and authorization process.
actions.evidence: The report records ca-sandbox, ca-new-skill, ca-watch, and ca-tribunal as not-executed.

actions.title: Write the Academy binding record
actions.instruction: Ask the selected host to create only .codearbiter/reports/academy/U06-preview.json from the committed candidate and current prepared attempt, with canonical JSON and the four not-executed classifications. This is an Academy binding record, not ca-preview output: do not add reviewer predictions, scan status, or a claim that the host command ran. Do not stage or commit it yet.
actions.rationale: The record binds durable repository facts without pretending to preserve telemetry from a read-only plugin command.

actions.expected_result: Only the Academy binding record is modified; it binds the prepared commit, candidate commit, tree, path, SHA-256, and one changed path without claiming ca-preview telemetry.
actions.recovery: If a field is not a repository binding or a not-executed classification, omit it. Do not invent placeholder SHA values, scan status, reviewer predictions, or invocation proof.
actions.evidence: The second learner commit may contain only this canonical Academy record.

actions.title: Inspect the Academy binding record
actions.instruction: Inspect the unstaged binding record and candidate state in a native terminal. This direct command has no !.
actions.rationale: The learner verifies the repository-evidence boundary before it becomes immutable history.
actions.expected_result: The record names only the candidate binding, read_only true, and four not-executed surfaces; it contains no reviewer, scan, or invocation claim.
actions.recovery: If any binding is absent, malformed, or claims ca-preview telemetry or an executed advanced surface, stop before staging.
actions.evidence: Canonical JSON bytes and exact Academy record keys are part of the Check profile.

actions.title: Stage only the report
actions.instruction: Stage only the binding report in a native terminal. This direct command has no !.
actions.rationale: The strict second commit rejects an extra changed path.
actions.expected_result: The staged name list contains only .codearbiter/reports/academy/U06-preview.json.
actions.recovery: If another path appears, stop and inspect the attempt. Do not broaden the report commit.
actions.evidence: The report must be the second and final learner commit.

actions.title: Commit the evidence through the gate
actions.instruction: Run the host-native commit gate only after the staged report is correct. This is not a shell command and has no !.
actions.rationale: The final evidence enters history through the same governed route as the candidate.
actions.expected_result: The report is the final direct child of the candidate commit.
actions.recovery: If the gate stops, keep the attempt inspectable and resolve only the stated issue. Do not amend or rewrite the candidate commit.
actions.evidence: The Check profile requires exactly two clean linear learner commits after preparation.

actions.title: Confirm the clean evidence boundary
actions.instruction: Confirm that the attempt has no tracked or untracked changes. This native terminal check has no !.
actions.rationale: A valid U06 report cannot compensate for leftover worktree state.
actions.recovery: If anything prints, stop and inspect it; do not delete, reset, or hide it to force a clean result.
actions.evidence: The semantic Check rejects dirty and untracked paths.

actions.title: Check the committed evidence
actions.instruction: Use the installed Academy Check command after the exact two-commit evidence packet is clean.
actions.rationale: Installed Academy availability and source-level semantic acceptance are different claims.
actions.expected_result: Preview 0.22 accepts the exact prepared candidate, two committed evidence paths, and clean worktree.
actions.recovery: If Check fails, preserve the attempt and repair only the reported evidence mismatch. Do not rewrite history or edit source fixtures.
actions.evidence: Check limit: source Check verifies committed repository facts, not a host invocation, a human interpretation, or an advanced command execution.

actions.title: Reset a failed U06 attempt safely
actions.instruction: Use the installed Academy Reset command only when you need a retry; it archives the failed attempt before preparing the next one.
actions.rationale: Recovery preserves evidence; it is not a destructive Git cleanup recipe.
actions.expected_result: Preview 0.22 archives the failed attempt and prepares an independent retry.
actions.recovery: Do not simulate a retry with reset --hard, branch deletion, or history rewriting; use the Academy Reset record.
actions.evidence: The archived attempt reference and new prepared branch prove recovery preserved learner history.
